entry.title: Grain Belt Brewery (Wikipedia — did you know?)

entry.title: Madmuin Hasibuan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Madmuin Hasibuan's father punished him for not fasting in Ramadan by not giving him food for three days?

entry.title: a song (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that SZA named a song after a well-known film director, but was shocked to get his blessing days after release?

entry.title: a former French secret-service agent (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a former French secret-service agent was responsible for seven out of the 26 Formula One drivers qualifying for the 1980 South African Grand Prix being French?

entry.title: Josaphat Park (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Josaphat Park, according to tradition, was named for its valley's striking resemblance to the Valley of Josaphat in the Holy Land?

entry.title: Deborah D. Rogers (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Deborah D. Rogers used Ann Radcliffe's commonplace book to show that Radcliffe was not driven mad by her Gothic novels, but that she just had asthma?

entry.title: Mammillaria luethyi (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Mammillaria luethyi was not seen for 44 years after being discovered growing in a coffee can on the windowsill of Mrs Crosby's?

entry.title: Hayseed Stephens (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Zulu prince Hayseed Stephens played in the American Football League?

entry.content: ... that syncing zombie cookies can create a cookie that is almost impossible to delete?
